title: 第九章 天授禀赋武道之心第十章 十二经筋鹰爪圆满
content_zh:
封诊司大堂。
王安道与铁棠一左一右，分立而坐，旁边有一白丁躬着身躯给两人备茶。
得知了十三具尸身的死亡时间，铁棠也并没有离去。
死者的身份还没搞清，线索还是不多，他在等候手下的消息。
“铁头，不是我说你，你也别一股心思闷在案子上，还是要多抽点时间出来修炼修炼。
案子是破不完的，你如今虽是总捕头，倘若不提升修为，官职也就到这了。
想要做到郡捕的位置......不成巫觋境是不可能的。”
朝廷对于担任各项职位，并没有明确的修为要求。
不过谁都知道，一个肉身境在这武力通天的世界，官职再高也有限。
如果不是那位总郡捕破格提升，总捕头的位置哪里轮得到铁棠？
类似的劝诫话语王安道已经说过很多次了。
他来到运城已有五载，与铁棠二人年纪相仿，趣味相投，很快成为了好友。
期间不知劝了多少次，让铁棠多加修炼。
只不过铁棠的前身并没有听从，反而一门心思扑在破案上面，疏忽了自身修炼。
若非如此，他也不会被清水郡的总郡捕直接越级提升。
但也因此，前身在一月之前的谋杀当中，不幸殒命。
孰错孰对，现在看来似乎有了结果。
铁棠深以为然的点了点头，看向身旁这位好友。
“老王，你的修为.....到了何种境界？”
“不久前，侥幸突破到了换血大圆满。”

“什么？”铁棠大惊。
似是怕他不信，王安道站起身来，双腿轻轻一抖，隆起的筋肉如同波浪一般滚动，隔着宽大的官服都看得一清二楚。
与此同时，僻静的大堂如同掀起了海啸。
哗啦啦，哗啦啦！
一股股海潮之声不绝于耳，好似江河汇聚，龙腾大海。
这仅仅只是王安道鼓动周身气血的声音。
淡淡的血腥味顺着铁棠鼻尖钻入，他感觉周身突然火热起来，眼前这位好友如同一座熔炉，正在散发无匹热量。
其光芒不显，内里蕴含的威能却如大日巡天，不可直视。
“如何？”
“我已替换周身九成九的旧血，只待贯通脑后两处天冲穴，便可彻底褪去肉体凡胎，复返先天真身。”
“厉...害！”铁棠起身后退几步，躲避好友威势，认真吐出二个字。
两人年纪相仿，王安道今年二十一岁，铁棠二十岁，可修为实力却差距非常大。
要说铁棠没有一点羡慕，那是假的。
“哈哈，我这算什么，肉身秘境只是修炼的第一步。
只有迈入巫觋秘境，才算是真正踏入武道之路。”王安道收起气势，重新坐了下来。
铁棠上前捏了捏好友臂膀，只觉与自己相差无几，并不能看出什么，不禁问道：“易筋、洗髓我能理解，可这换血境，有什么说法吗？”
content_en:
The lobby of the closed clinic.
Wang Andao and Tie Tang sat separately, one on the left and the other on the right. Next to them was a white man who was hunched over preparing tea for the two of them.
After learning the death time of the thirteen corpses, Tie Tang did not leave.
The identity of the deceased has not yet been clarified, and there are still not many clues. He is waiting for news from his men.
"Tietou, I'm not telling you, don't focus on the case, you should take more time to practice.
There are endless cases to be solved. Although you are the chief arrester now, if you don't improve your cultivation level, your official position will only end here.
If you want to achieve the position of county arrester... it is impossible without reaching the witchcraft realm. "
The imperial court did not have clear cultivation requirements for holding various positions.
But everyone knows that in a world where the physical body is full of martial arts, no matter how high the official position is, it is limited.
If it hadn't been for the extraordinary promotion of the chief county catcher, where would Tie Tang be in the position of chief catcher?
Wang Andao has said similar words of advice many times.
He has been in Yuncheng for five years. He and Tie Tang are similar in age and have similar interests, and they quickly became good friends.
I don’t know how many times I persuaded Tie Tang to practice more.
However, Tie Tang's predecessor did not obey. Instead, he focused on solving the case and neglected his own cultivation.
If not, he would not have been directly promoted by the chief commander of Qingshui County.
But because of this, his predecessor unfortunately died in a murder a month ago.
Which one is wrong and which one is right? Now it seems that there is a result.
Tie Tang nodded in agreement and looked at his friend beside him.
"Old Wang, what level has your cultivation level reached?"
"Not long ago, I was lucky enough to achieve the consummation of blood exchange."
"What?" Tie Tang was shocked.
As if he was afraid that he would not believe it, Wang Andao stood up and shook his legs slightly. The bulging muscles rolled like waves, which could be clearly seen through the wide official uniform.
At the same time, it was like a tsunami had set off in the quiet lobby.
Blah blah blah!
The sound of waves is endless, like rivers converging and dragons rising into the sea.
This is just the sound of Wang Andao inciting the energy and blood all over his body.
The faint smell of blood penetrated along the tip of Tie Tang's nose, and he felt that his whole body suddenly became hot. The friend in front of him was like a furnace, emitting incomparable heat.
Its light is not visible, but the power contained within is like the sun patrolling the sky, which cannot be looked directly at.
"How?"
"I have replaced 99% of the old blood in my body. I only need to penetrate the two Tianchong points on the back of my head to completely shed my mortal body and return to my innate true body."
"Awesome!" Tie Tang stood up and took a few steps back to avoid his friend's power, and said these two words seriously.
The two are similar in age, Wang Andao is 21 years old and Tie Tang is 20 years old, but there is a huge gap in their cultivation strength.
It would be a lie to say that Tie Tang was not envious at all.
"Haha, what am I doing? The secret realm of the physical body is just the first step in cultivation.
Only by entering the secret realm of witchcraft can one truly enter the path of martial arts. "Wang Andao put away his momentum and sat down again.
Tie Tang stepped forward and squeezed his friend's arm. He felt that it was almost the same as his own, and he couldn't tell anything. He couldn't help but ask: "I can understand Yijin and marrow cleansing, but what is the explanation for this blood exchange state?"
